'''Hidden Chain Fleet Ships'''<ref name="HiddenChainFleetShip"/> were modified [[Leviathan-class transport|''Leviathan''-class transports]]<ref name="HiddenChainFleetShip"/> that were used by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of the [[Hidden Chain]] as [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. At least four of these vessels were stationed on [[Ruhnuk]] during the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian civil war]]<ref name="TOR:OI" /> and two of then fought the forces of [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]] during to the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]].<ref name="TOR:SoR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Showdown on Ruhnuk|Ruhnuk}}</ref> Later, a [[Hidden Chain flagship|Hidden Chain Ship]] was used to transport the [[Holocron Machine]] manufactured by the Hidden Chain leader [[Heta Kol]] to create an army of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] soldiers. The ship was eventually destroyed when the [[Eternal Alliance]] [[Mission to Hidden Chain Ship|boarded]] the vessel to destroy the machine and recover [[Darth Nul's holocron]].<ref name="TOR:Sundering">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Sundering|Hidden Chain Ship}}</ref>
